baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default (as in CALIB-01), 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, pooled in seed order (73601..73605, tick order) = 1950 ticks/domain expected. Estimator runs over the pooled stream with NO reset at seed boundaries (same information structure as the sequential-climatology baseline). Deterministic; stdlib only.

config.protocol: 1950-tick CALIB-01 protocol (5 fresh seeds x 10 eps, changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect=none)

hypothesis: One-sided conformal transducer probabilities (rolling fit + rolling calibration split) beat sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_conf < Brier_climo.
interpretation: REJECTED. Conformal transducer (one-sided, rolling F=100/C=200) beats sequential climatology on 0/4 domains (skills -0.005..-0.272). The ablation (rolling point forecast + Gaussian bridge) also fails 0/4. On a near-stationary stream the running average is already near-optimal; the conformal machinery adds estimation noise without adaptivity gain. Synthetic check confirms the transducer is well-calibrated on iid data (no implementation bug) — it is simply not better than climatology here. Full NR entry.
limitations: Single env (changing_rule), closed loop; calibration conditional on the visited distribution.; Pooled-stream estimator sees seed-boundary discontinuities (same order as baseline; limitation shared with it).; Exchangeability assumed by the transducer is violated by the closed-loop nonstationarity; the rolling windows are the mitigation, and the gate is the judge.; affect='none' matches CALIB-01.
null_hypothesis: Brier_conf >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): the conformal wrapper adds no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_conf vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_conf < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
